overall: MARGINAL this morning during the pickup; GOOD on most grounds from about 11 AM to 4 PM
limiterDetail: The main limiter is current in the south and west at the pickups, plus wind in the west early today and again before dawn Wednesday. Wind now is 3.3–12.1 kt (gusts 7–17): Nangalao 12, Barangonan 11, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 10.5, and only about 3–5 kt on the Coron side. It eases to under 6 kt almost everywhere from about 11 AM, except Nangalao (7–10 kt). Rain is minor: brief light showers about 6–9 AM (up to 1.1 mm/h at Cabunlawan and Decabaitot), then mostly dry; 24h totals 0.0–4.5 mm. The current picks up now to about 10 AM (peak about 7–9 AM), eases about 11 AM–4 PM , picks up again about 5–9 PM (peak 6–8 PM), then goes slack about 11 PM–4 AM Wed.

The latest items (to Mon 26 Oct 5:26 AM PHT) are final general flood advisories for the Visayas regions, none covering Palawan.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: No material change to near-term supply: arrivals stay normal through Wednesday. We are at the start of the morning current pickup, so the grounds read 7 GOOD / 6 MARGINAL / 3 POOR / 0 VERY POOR right now (was 10 / 6 / 0 / 0 at 2 PM in the easy-current window, and 4 / 6 / 5 / 1 at yesterday's 6 AM pickup). Decabaitot, Alava and Turda are POOR on current; Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Barangonan are MARGINAL on wind.

Week shifts: Thu 29 is now windier but drier (14 kt, gusts 21, 2.1 mm; was 12 kt, gusts 18, 9.7 mm), still the hardest day. Fri 30 is calmer (5.9 kt, gusts 18, dry; was 9.0 kt). Sat 31 is much drier (4.6 mm; was 11.2 mm) and now rates GOOD (6.8 kt, gusts 12). Sun 1 is breezier (11 kt, gusts 17, 3.3 mm). Mon 2 rates GOOD (8.2 kt, gusts 14, 3.6 mm). PAGASA has nothing for Palawan.

bestWindow.headline: Today about 11 AM–4 PM, then tonight 11 PM–1 AM on the sheltered grounds
details: 11 AM–4 PM: Galoc, Maglalambay, Decabobo and Panlaitan 0.1–0.2, Linapacan 0.2, Culion 0.2–0.3, Coron 0.4–0.5; wind 0–6 kt, mostly dry. This is the calmest daytime window of the week.
11 PM–1 AM tonight: slack at Coron, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay, Decabobo, Alava and Binudac (0.0–0.2), wind about 1–3 kt. On the Coron side it stays slack and fairly calm until about 4 AM.

Keep small boats off Decabaitot, Tara, Turda and Alava during the 7–9 AM and 6–8 PM peaks, and off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan from about 2 AM Wed when the wind reaches 13–18 kt.
